name: no-red-flags
description: Remove 40+ design red flags that make an interface look AI-generated: purple gradients, cardocalypse, eyebrow labels on every heading, colored pill tags, icon tiles, glassmorphism, fake social proof, and modal dumping.

interface.shortDescription: Catch and fix the design patterns that make a UI look AI-generated.
interface.longDescription: Audits, fixes, or builds UI so that none of the known AI design tells appear: the purple gradient, the cream-and-italic-serif default, cards inside cards, eyebrow labels on every heading, colored pill tags, oversized icon tiles, glassmorphism and glows, fake social proof, the pulsing green dot, the conveyor-belt landing page, and modal dumping. It keeps your brand, content, and functionality, states a design direction first, and lists what it changed.
defaultPrompt: Use /no-red-flags to fix this component: (paste code)
Use /no-red-flags to detect AI design red flags in this page
Use /no-red-flags to build a landing page for (product)
